about.title: About me
about.body.1: I'm a Computer Science student constantly seeking learning and professional growth. I pick up new subjects quickly, communicate well, and take responsibility seriously, and I enjoy working in teams that value collaboration and knowledge sharing.
about.body.2: I'm deeply interested in technology and keep expanding my knowledge through study, college, and new experiences. I also study English independently, working on my communication and comprehension of the language.
about.body.3: I'm open to opportunities that let me gain experience, apply what I've been developing, and explore new areas within technology. My goal is to keep growing professionally and personally, building new skills and contributing positively to the teams and projects I'm part of.
